subject: maths
question: The ratio of the volume of first and second cylinder is 32 ∶ 9 and the ratio of their heights is 8 ∶ 9. If the area of the base of the second cylinder is 616 cm², then what will be the radius of the first cylinder?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **Volumes** (V₁/V₂) = (r₁/r₂)² × (h₁/h₂)

32/9 = (r₁/r₂)² × (8/9) ⇒ (r₁/r₂)² = 4 ⇒ r₁/r₂ = 2/1

**Base Area** of second cylinder = 616 cm² ⇒ πr₂² = 616 ⇒ r₂ = 14 cm

**Radius** of first cylinder (r₁) = 2 × r₂ = 2 × 14 = 28 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 28 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Ratio of **Volumes** = 32 : 9, Ratio of **Heights** = 8 : 9, **Base Area** of 2ⁿd cylinder = 616 cm².

**Formula Used:** Volume of **Cylinder** = Base Area × Height

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/acd11ded285ffb9d0a1886a97b13357940389a3d8856036753a3263898651acd.png] 

⇒ V₁ / V₂ = (Area₁ × h₁) / (Area₂ × h₂)

⇒ 32 / 9 = (Area₁ / 616) × (8 / 9)

⇒ 32 / 8 = Area₁ / 616

⇒ Area₁ = 4 × 616 = 2464 cm²

⇒ π × r₁² = 2464

⇒ 22/7 × r₁² = 2464

⇒ r₁² = (2464 × 7) / 22 = 112 × 7 = 784

⇒ r₁ = √784 = 28 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 28 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Cylinder

The volume (V) is calculated as the product of the base area and the height: V = πr²h.

Surface Area of a Cylinder

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2πrh and Total Surface Area (TSA) = 2πr(r + h).

Radius and Area Relation

If the base area is A, then the radius r = √(A/π). For A = 616 cm², r = 14 cm.</p
